texts.facts: Thus the petitioner is constrained to move the present writ petition. The Drugs Inspector merely accepting the statement of the tenth respondent is unacceptable and the Drugs Inspector was very much knowing about the advertisements given by the tenth respondent visibly on the product and in the label. In such circumstances, the Drugs Inspector with reference to the advertisements has to take samples and sent it for laboratory test, identify the character and nature of the products and if any illegality or wrongful information is provided, then prosecute the persons under the relevant Statutes. 7. The Report submitted by Smt.S.Dhanalakshmi, the Drugs Inspector would indicate that she had failed to perform her duties as required under law. Therefore, the Director of Drugs Control has to conduct an enquiry and initiate appropriate actions against the said Drugs Inspector, namely, Smt.S.Dhanalakshmi, if she had failed to do her duties in initiating appropriate actions against such misleading advertisements or lapses, negligence or dereliction of duty.
texts.arguments: Any false or misleading advertisements of drugs or other products are made, then the Authorities Competent are bound to invoke the provisions of the Act and prosecute the persons in the manner https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis contemplated.

annotations_dropped.text_preview: 5. Pertinently, the official respondents have not filed any counter-affidavit in the present writ petition, despite the fact that the present writ petition is pending for the past about four years.
The inaction and omission on the part of the official respondents in dealing with such serious matters are to be deprecated.

In view of the facts and circumstances, this Court has no other option, but to direct the respondents 1 to 9 to depute an Officer not below the rank of Assistant Director of Drugs Control to conduct an inspection in the tenth respondent sho
The said enquiry or action to be initiated by the Authorities are directed to be monitored by the fourth respondent-Director of Drugs Control.
The abovesaid exercise is directed to be completed by the respondents 1 to 9, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
9. With the above directions, the present writ petition stands allowed.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
